description: This file defines extension methods for integrating Kubernetes hosting support into Orleans silos and services via dependency injection. It provides overloads for configuring Kubernetes hosting in different contexts, registering necessary options, validators, and lifecycle components.

classes.name: KubernetesHostingExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for adding Kubernetes hosting support to Orleans silos and services.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting (ISiloBuilder)
methods.description: Configures an ISiloBuilder to use Kubernetes hosting with default options.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting (ISiloBuilder, Action<OptionsBuilder<KubernetesHostingOptions>>)
methods.description: Configures an ISiloBuilder to use Kubernetes hosting with custom options.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting (IServiceCollection)
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to a service collection with default options.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting (IServiceCollection, Action<OptionsBuilder<KubernetesHostingOptions>>)
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to a service collection with custom options.
